cases.condition: Exact 5.1.1 synthetic profile, independent parent receipt, and all selected hash-bound task artifacts pass every local gate.
cases.minimum_next_action: Retain the synthetic report and obtain legal real-artifact evidence before any promotion review.

cases.condition: Provider version or environment profile differs from the only pinned profile.
cases.minimum_next_action: Create and forward-validate a separate exact-version profile.

cases.condition: Declared parent SHA-256 differs from the exact bytes read by the auditor.
cases.minimum_next_action: Restore the immutable parent record or issue a reviewed lineage replacement.

cases.condition: Parent gates self-report pass but no independently hash-bound validation receipt matches the current parent bytes.
cases.minimum_next_action: Produce an independent validation receipt bound to the current parent and gate-evidence hashes.

cases.condition: Structure, k-point, potential metadata, settings, protocol, or wavefunction identity differs across parent, declaration, and execution records.
cases.minimum_next_action: Regenerate one atomic handoff from the exact DFT parent and execution records.

cases.condition: A fatal marker is present or the exact-profile completion marker is absent.
cases.minimum_next_action: Preserve the failed run, diagnose it, and provide a new complete artifact.

cases.condition: Absolute charge or total spilling is absent, invalid, or exceeds the predeclared threshold.
cases.minimum_next_action: Reassess parent quality and basis choice without post-hoc threshold relaxation.

cases.condition: Projected-band fraction, projection energy window, or projection Fermi evidence is incomplete.
cases.minimum_next_action: Supply projection-population and reference-window evidence before curve analysis.

cases.condition: Curve sign, integral semantics, Fermi reference, or energy window is absent or detached from lobsterout evidence.
cases.minimum_next_action: Re-export the curve with an explicit convention and matching projection reference.

cases.condition: The request asks automation to conclude bond existence, order, strength, oxidation state, stability, or causality.
cases.minimum_next_action: Limit automation to technical evidence and obtain an independent expert decision.

cases.condition: No earlier condition can be established from exact bounded evidence.
cases.minimum_next_action: Stop and obtain enough exact bounded evidence to select one earlier case deterministically.
